title: Banshee Vowel
description: A screaming sawtooth formant lead that cycles through vowel shapes while a slow triangle-and-saw pair drags a resonant bandpass across its throat. Over a 24-cycle pass the pitch climbs in stepped octave leaps, the vibrato deepens, and the drive bites harder before everything smears into a long delay-and-room tail.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 [c4 d4] f4 eb4 [g4 f4] c5 [eb4 d4] f4>/2")
    .add(note("<0 0 12 0 7 12>/4"))
    .s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o a e i a o>/3")
    .vib(saw.slow(23).range(4, 9)).vibmod(tri.slow(13).range(0.4, 2.6))
    .bpf(tri.slow(16).range(420, 3600).add(saw.slow(11).range(0, 900)))
    .resonance(sine.slow(29).range(9, 19))
    .shape(tri.slow(13).range(0.18, 0.62))
    .distort(saw.slow(17).range(0.1, 0.7))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.5))
    .sometimesBy(0.16, x => x.speed(-1))
    .room(0.45).roomsize(0.7)
    .delay("0.5:0.375:0.6").orbit(2)
    .gain(0.85)
)
